name: Nalpak
summary: Nalpak is a tauren druid disciple who watches over the troubled Wailing Caverns in the Barrens. Stationed in the high cliff-cave overlooking the cavern entrance, he enlists passing adventurers to help contain the nightmare twisting the subterranean ecosystem.

sections.title: Watcher Above the Caverns
sections.body: Perched inside a hidden cavern directly above the mouth of the Wailing Caverns, Nalpak remains loyal to the vision of Archdruid Naralex. While his master lies trapped in a corrupted slumber deep below, Nalpak works to keep the spreading corruption at bay. He asks adventurers to gather deviate hides for use as leather.

faq.answer: Nalpak is located in a cave high up on the rock face directly above the natural rock formation that leads into the Wailing Caverns in the central Barrens.

He is a tauren druid and one of the Disciples of Naralex, tasked with monitoring the emergence of twisted creatures from the Wailing Caverns while his master attempts to restore the Barrens through the Emerald Dream.

faq.q: Why does Nalpak want deviate hides?
faq.answer: Nalpak wants to examine the hides of the deviate creatures infesting the Wailing Caverns. Despite their evil nature, he believes their unusual hides can be put to good use in leatherworking.

faq.q: What is Nalpak's relationship to Naralex?
faq.answer: Nalpak is a faithful student and follower of Archdruid Naralex, serving as one of the disciples sent to support the ambitious attempt to reawaken the springs of the Barrens.

angles.text: For fellow druids, Nalpak is a grim reminder of how perilous touching the Emerald Dream can be when darkness takes root in what was meant to be a restorative ritual.
Nalpak represents the tauren dedication to healing the parched lands of Kalimdor, refusing to abandon the mission even when disaster strikes the dreamers.
